# CCMA engine fixtures -- FICTIONAL

Every award in this folder is **invented test data**. The parties, case
numbers, commissioners, facts and findings do not exist. They follow the
published layout of SAFLII's ZACCMA collection so the parsers can be tested
without touching the network, as the spec's worked example requires.

`saflii_ccma_sample.html` deliberately contains a (checksum-valid, invented)
South African ID number, an e-mail address, a phone number and a street
address, so tests can prove none of them reach a knowledge unit.

Never seed these files into a real catalogue.
